MiniMax built its new image model on H3, its popular open-weight video model, calling it the strongest open-weight image model released so far.

- Output up to 20 MP, with 1K, 2K and 4K presets or exact width and height

Image output from $3.80 per million tokens, with 50% off 4K outputs on both models through November 17
